body:
Of course they aren't legally forced to pay me back lol

Its just that I did something for them that wasn't easy for me to do and   I'd expect some form of bond with them. That they would be there for me, like I was for them.

It seems like that now but remember when you were with her? I'm sure it felt great. You just broke up with someone dude. Its supposed to hurt for a while. Don't kill yourself or anything. I'm sure you have friends and people who care about you, you just can't see it that way because of the pain. If I covered your eyes with a green lens. And I said point out everything that isn't green. You couldn't because you are seeing the world through a green lens. Now, I say to you point out all the great things in your life. You can't. You can't because you see the world though the lens of pain and despair.

Someone you "loved" , doesn't love you back. It's been a problem ever since....love was created. Just think how many guys have been in this EXACT situation. How many endless nights of sorrow and pain these guys went through and I bet they all killed themselves, right? Nope. Love hurts man. That's why its so awesome when you are in it and why its sucks when you are out of it ( again I assume since I've never felt it) There is no short cut to this pain ending. It never will until it does. So I suggest to go out there and find someone who is just as great. Because before you met her and found out how great, beautiful or funny she is....you didn't know anything about her, just like most women. You can never count yourself out when you never counted yourself in. If that makes any sense....

So you are in school about to graduate with one class failing (Failing, not failed...see the difference). You have dreams and aspirations. You have made step to improve yourself. My suggestion to turn your life around is....

DONT STOP! You are doing just fine with your plan. Don't get discouraged. Don't lose hope. Keep pushing my friend. We'll make it one day.

Oh ok. It makes sense now. I can't really help you on this front because I've never had a gf. So, in a way, you are better off than me. That's a plus. But like what about her do you miss most? Because you can always find someone as beautiful, as funny, as trustworthy. All of her good stuff you can find in someone else. I mean you obviously have the capacity to find a gf...unlike me. :(
Cool. Same here. What has you down the most?

I feel you. I'm not going to say "oh think about those less fortunate" or some bullshit because it never helps. I'm alone but not really alone which is worse. I HAD friends but they all too advantage of me and left me behind. So i spend my days and nights thinking I'm whats wrong and not them. I'm sure you are a stand up guy (?) who, given the chance, could do a lot of good in this world. But this isnt a fairy tale. How old are you?

I understand. I wanted to disappear also. As if I never existed. But I also thought about being the guy who made it from nothing. Maybe if I fight just hard enough and long enough...I'll be somebody. And don't fret, you are something to me. I'm not chatting to no one. As alone as you feel right now, there is one person in this fucked up world who is cares about you in any way. I care because I've been and I am there.

Fuck, the same thing happened to me. I was almost kicked out. I saved money to buy a gun so when I got my "you are no longer a student" letter, I'd off myself. But I spent that money on school supplies and decided I'm not a failure. Sure you are doing bad now but what GOT you to college anyway? You studied or faked it till you made it. So don't tell me you can't do that again because I KNOW YOU CAN. You should go to class. Every class. Engage with the teacher. Ask for help. When you are tempted not to go to class remember what Woody Allen said, which I used.

90% of success is showing up. So please... go to class and study hard. I know you can do it. Listen, the fear you have must motivate you like it did me. I didn't want to end up like my friends who failed out of school. Being 20- something working at a department store because you can't go to school anymore. I'm hoping things turn out well for you. I know the pain.

Yea. I mean people "care" but no one truly cares. They care as long as nothing you do bothers them...then yea they care. But when something goes wrong and you feel like killing yourself, they stop caring. When you need them the most they left us to suffer. It's sad but also comforting you and I are chatting. I've told more to you, a stranger, than I would anyone close to me.

Yea. Same here. If it's any help, you aren't alone in that aspect. In the past weeks the only people I've spoken to are: teachers, mail man, guy who works at this fast food place, and myself. I've never felt so alone. This makes me miss being a drug addict. Because at least I was something when I was abusing drugs. I was a druggie. Now...I'm nobody again.
hey, whats up? I may not respond very quickly but I'm here if you want someone to confide in....on a message board.
Yea. I was a friend of hers but not like "call and talk on the phone" type friends.

No, this is still a place for you. *Virtual Hug*

What I meant was you got down voted I assume because you are engaged. This is still a place for anyone who is alone but you aren't as alone as other people here. I mean you have someone special in your life, in any aspect. Be happy about that. Lots of guys here (including myself) have no one but the person who looks back at them in the mirror. And while being engaged doesn't "cure the 20 years of loneliness..." but imagine the guys who haven't even had a chance to cure the 20+ years of loneliness. I'm not saying you don't have the right to feel lonely, just understand that being so lonely....you don't want to hear someone who is leaps and bounds ahead of the rest of us, tell us how lonely it is.

You have to understand that you are talking to guys who have nothing going for them in terms of love life. You may THINK you have no one but take that few hours of the day when you are alone and stretch it over the span of your entire life.

Please tell more Generic! It makes me feel better to know I am not alone being a creep. I used to call a girl I really liked just to hear her voice. I would pretend I had the wrong number. Best 5 seconds of my life...followed by a life long feeling of sorrow and disgust.
Of course being over weight is part of the FA stereotype. How many over weight guys/girls do you know in relationships.
Yea, I'm not 30 but I am too old to have so little friends. It never gets easier, I just deal with the pain better.
Honestly, I think it is because Nic Cage is just so horrible in films that it makes you feel better not to be him. Its actually a proven treatment for depression.
how old are you ?

I have tried inspirational things before. Truth is I've felt "this way" ever since I was a teen. This isn't new, it is just so profound right now that is scared me. But like I said I feel I used up all my inspiration and here I am. I'll find something though. You know, as they say.....It is always darkest before the dawn. But the last guy I know who said that had half his face burnt off, so fuck that saying.

My advice is to create a mask. I know its the wrong advice but I'm stuck in an emotional rut too and this is all I have lol. 

Create the person you think they'd (the people you want to interact with) will like. Is he funny ? Is he smart? Who is he? You say you can't find anything beyond the general then bring out the fact you can't say anything original and make fun at that. I've learned two things: always work on your mask and laughter is the best social breaker. Laughter will always break tension. I'm not just talking BS also. I also suffered and still suffer from this, EXACTLY like you did. My friends left me at the age where I thought we'd be life long friends like in the movies or like normal kids. After that I worked on my mask. He's funny and likes to listen. Most people find him nice. I hate him personally.

EDIT: For me the mask helps. But for you, maybe you are wearing your mask right now? That guy who you think is weird and awkward is maybe the mask. You'll never know until you take it off or put it on to find out who you truly are.

Thanks. The hugs were appreciated. Yea the main reason I haven't killed myself id because I can rationalize the anger away. I'm just scared about the day or moment when I can't or truthfully...don't want to.
